posts.headline: Nine editions of hiding ended and The Thicks finally sat in the chair — now the receipts are locked in and #FreeMaxx Champions has to live with whatever it just built.
posts.detail: That 14-14 career record and a 5.5 average finish is the reality behind the ring, and this draft was the chance to prove it wasn't a fluke — the tape is rolling now, no more excuses left to hide behind.

posts.headline: Sixteen editions of torching Put it in Ra and still not a peep — but the draft board is closed now, and a 20-8 juggernaut with back-to-back top-2 finishes has officially run out of ways to dodge the pressure.
posts.detail: Two straight top-2 finishes and zero rings is a resume begging for a title, and now that the picks are locked in, One Nut Barner either finally breaks through or the silence starts sounding a lot more like dread.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh just finished a draft from the deepest hole in the league, and the untalented tenth better have actually drafted like it knows it's dead last.
posts.detail: A 4-10, 12th-place debut is the floor of this entire league, and there's no more hiding behind 'the draft hasn't happened yet' — the tenth has a roster now, and it's on tape.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World dragged a championship banner through five straight editions of fluke accusations, and now that the draft is done, Big Head has to actually stand on the picks.
posts.detail: A losing 13-15 career record and 5.5 average finish is still the resume attached to that title, and no amount of draft-night spin changes the math until games are actually played.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh survived seven straight editions of silence and burial, and the draft is finally over — now the excuses are gone and the roster has to speak for itself.
posts.detail: An 11th-place, 5-9 debut was the ceiling last time, and with the picks locked in, the Prince of Persia either built a throne or just drafted another year in the basement.
